The '''''Journal of Mathematical Analysis and Applications''''' is an [[academic journal]] in mathematics, specializing in [[mathematical analysis]] and related topics in [[applied mathematics]]. It was founded in 1960 by [[Richard E. Bellman|Richard Bellman]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Editorial board |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-mathematical-analysis-and-applications}}</ref> as part of a series of new journals on areas of mathematics published by [[Academic Press]],<ref>{{citation|title=Encyclopedia of Library and Information Science|edition=2nd|volume=3|editor-first=Miriam|editor-last=Drake|publisher=CRC Press|year=2003|isbn=9780824720797|page=1812|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Sqr-_3FBYiYC&pg=PA1812}}</ref> and is now published by [[Elsevier]]. For most years since 2003 it has been ranked by [[SCImago Journal Rank]] as among the top 25% of journals in its topic areas.<ref>[http://www.scimagojr.com/journalsearch.php?q=23935&tip=sid SCImagoJR report on the ''Journal of Mathematical Analysis and Applications''], retrieved 2017-08-17</ref>
